svg.title: cns 9 caching example
svg.desc: Hypothetical caching reports. Read-reuse/write-fraction and external-contention rivals lock predictions before randomized cache measurements. Offered arrivals and external background work are controlled, not downstream utilization. Latency and freshness are both scored; unresolved outcomes remain possible.
